**Management Summary (119 words)**  

The €160,242 LV contains €9.4 k of items flagged for non‑compliance with DIN 18300/18331, VOB/C and GEG requirements. The most critical gaps are missing homogeneity‑area specifications (2 × €1.26 k + €630 + €300), absent insulation thickness and thermal‑conductivity data (€1.15 k + €768), and undefined water‑exposure classes for earth‑contacted elements (€1.01 k + €560). Additional medium‑risk omissions affect paving, compaction, concrete mix, and exposure class details, while low‑risk items lack curing, joint, and finish information. These deficiencies expose the project to design‑review rework, regulatory penalties and durability risks. Immediate action: revise all tender texts to include the mandatory DIN/VOB specifications, update cost estimates accordingly, and re‑validate the risk register.
